about: Zip-up polo (polo-shirt-textured.glb, MODELQ5 2026-11-19, cards 27480 / 27486): coloured from the same garment split into 17 parts by Tripo (polo-shirt-parts.glb) by viewer/tripo-glbparts.mjs: the body, hem band, shoulder and armhole seams the print; the stand-up collar the Collar colour, one even band down from its top (its inside too); the zip's slider and short tape (in the collar's part, keysWhere) the print, under our own zip: tape (the Collar colour), metal teeth and a metal pull at the top, from the bottom of the collar's V straight down the centre front to the hem as our own tape (the Collar colour) and metal teeth (zipLine: data `zip`, main.js); each sleeve its own piece (Left / Right sleeve: its own colour, else the Sleeves area, else the print laid on the made sleeve, sleeveMap, so a pattern's or a design picture's sleeve colours show), its seam with the body one smooth line; each cuff an even band (the trim colour) on its sleeve (cuffOn). Stitch lines: the collar's foot, a cuff line and a hem line. Data ownPlacket: no printed button placket; insideCloth.
